2609.21595.title: Evaluating In-Context Learning and Retrieval Strategies for Devanagari Post-OCR Correction
2609.21595.paper_summary: In-context learning using Large Language Models (LLMs) offers a compelling path to training-free post-OCR correction, yet its effectiveness for Devanagari script remains entirely unexplored. We present the first systematic evaluation of LLMs (3B-32B) for post-OCR correction in Hindi and Marathi, comparing three in-context example retrieval strategies: domain-random selection, dense semantic retrieval, and our proposed CharBM25, which retrieves examples by character n-gram BM25 similarity over OCR inputs to target shared error patterns with the test sentence. Across a 20,000-sentence benchmark spanning five news domains, retrieval strategy is the decisive factor in correction quality: CharBM25 outperforms domain-random selection by 2.8-4.0pp absolute WER on Hindi and 2.9-3.8pp on Marathi, using character trigrams, which consistently outperform bigrams and unigrams. Scale dominates performance: Gemma-3-27B achieves WER reductions of 55.0% for Hindi and 33.3% for Marathi under CharBM25-5. Few-shot gains are capacity-gated: models below 8B do not reliably improve over the OCR baseline, and on Marathi the smallest models (3B) degrade more sentences than they improve. Marathi is persistently harder to correct than Hindi across all scales, reflecting its greater morphological complexity. These findings establish CharBM25 as an effective, GPU-free retrieval strategy that matches or exceeds dense retrieval at negligible computational cost, and show that combining it with a general-purpose LLM of 12B+ parameters delivers reliable, training-free Devanagari post-OCR correction without task-specific fine-tuning. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AbhishekBhandari/Devanagari-OCR-ICL-Benchmark
2609.21595.paper_summary_zh: 在使用大型語言模型 (LLMs) 的上下文學習中，提供了一條無需訓練的後 OCR 修正的引人注目的途徑，但其在天城文中的有效性仍然完全未被探索。我們首次系統性地評估了 LLMs (3B-32B) 在印地語和馬拉地語的後 OCR 修正中的表現，並比較了三種上下文示例檢索策略：領域隨機選擇、密集語義檢索以及我們提出的 CharBM25，該策略通過字符 n-gram BM25 相似度從 OCR 輸入中檢索示例，以針對與測試句子共享的錯誤模式。在涵蓋五個新聞領域的 20,000 句子基準測試中，檢索策略是修正質量的決定性因素：CharBM25 在印地語上比領域隨機選擇的絕對 WER 提高 2.8-4.0 個百分點，在馬拉地語上提高 2.9-3.8 個百分點，並使用字符三元組，這一表現始終優於二元組和單元組。規模主導性能：Gemma-3-27B 在 CharBM25-5 下實現了印地語 55.0% 和馬拉地語 33.3% 的 WER 降低。少量樣本的增益受到容量限制：8B 以下的模型無法可靠地改善 OCR 基線，而在馬拉地語中，最小的模型 (3B) 降低的句子數量超過了改善的數量。馬拉地語在所有規模中持續比印地語更難修正，反映出其更大的形態複雜性。這些發現確立了 CharBM25 作為一種有效的無 GPU 檢索策略，其性能與密集檢索相匹配或超過，且計算成本微不足道，並顯示將其與 12B+ 參數的一般用途 LLM 結合可以實現可靠的、無需訓練的天城文後 OCR 修正，而無需特定任務的微調。數據集：https://huggingface.co/datasets/AbhishekBhandari/Devanagari-OCR-ICL-Benchmark
